overview: El Salvador is the smallest country in Central America and the only one without a Caribbean coastline. Its capital and largest city is San Salvador. El Salvador became independent from Spain in 1821, at first as part of a Central American federation. It uses the US dollar, and in 2021 it became the first country to adopt Bitcoin as legal money.

geography.text: El Salvador faces the Pacific Ocean. A line of volcanoes runs across the country, and earthquakes are common. Between the volcanic highlands and the coastal plain lies a central plateau where most people live, and the Lempa is its main river.

history.text: El Salvador was home to the Pipil people before the Spanish conquest. It became independent in 1821 and was dominated for a long time by coffee-growing landowners. A civil war from 1980 to 1992 killed around 75,000 people and ended with peace accords.

events.title: Independence
events.text: El Salvador becomes independent from Spain.

events.title: La Matanza
events.text: Thousands of peasants are killed after an uprising.

events.title: Football War
events.text: A short war with Honduras follows World Cup qualifying matches.

events.title: Peace accords
events.text: A peace agreement ends twelve years of civil war.
